eventMetadata.context_description: Current short-range forecasts from the Israel Meteorological Service and global models indicate a daily high near 28–29°C in Tel Aviv for June 8, driving the market’s strong clustering around those outcomes. Typical early-summer conditions feature stable subtropical high pressure, light sea breezes, and minimal cloud cover that limit convective cooling while allowing rapid daytime warming under clear skies. Ensemble guidance shows tight agreement with little spread beyond 28–30°C, consistent with June climatology where mean maxima average 29–30°C at coastal stations. Final resolution will depend on the official 24-hour maximum recorded by 20:00 local time tomorrow, with any late-model shift in boundary-layer moisture or wind speed able to nudge the peak by 1°C.
